faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Education Office Sukma (DEO Sukma) in the state of Chhattisgarh to hire qualified educators for local schools.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Local Guest Teacher (Mathematics) post under advertisement number 366 /जि.परि.अ./स.शि./माध्य./अति.शि./2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the filled offline application form is 05-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated authority on or before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DEO Sukma Recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, and send it along with the required documents by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Local Guest Teacher post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Local Guest Teacher (Mathematics) position will receive a fixed consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 18,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Post Graduate degree in Mathematics. Candidates possessing a B.Ed qualification will be given preference during the selection process.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to any category including General, OBC, SC, and ST as per the notification details.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DEO Sukma Guest Teacher?
faq.answer: The selection is based on the merit of marks obtained in the qualifying examination. Additional priority is given to previous local guest teachers and local Gram Panchayat residents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this government notification?
faq.answer: This is a contractual government job opportunity intended to fill teaching positions locally within the district educational institutions of Sukma, Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can access and download the official notification PDF, advertisement details, and application format through the designated important links table provided within this article.
